indexedMaterials.source: Machine-readable conversion of all repo documents
indexedMaterials.location: indexed/ (per-doc JSON), indexed/catalog.json (metadata), indexed/_jsonl/*.jsonl (full-text bulk feeds)
indexedMaterials.note: Each document converted to JSON with cleaned full text; ad/watermark content removed (site names, contact info, social CTA, repeated footers). 121 scanned image-only PDFs have no text layer (OCR follow-up available). Originals preserved.

ocrPass.note: Scanned/image-only PDFs OCR'd with tesseract (LSTM). 11 corrupt PDFs have no extractable text.

imageIndex.note: Embedded images extracted from exams/lesson-notes/revision PDFs, OCR'd; per-image ocrText in each doc's JSON `images` array and in `imageOcrText`.

searchIndex.note: Inverted index over title+text+ocrText+imageOcrText. See search/README.md.
